Use-case and requirements summary (customer language / shorthand):

- Throughput targets: baseline 150-200 req/s with bursts up to 400 req/s; sustained embeddings jobs offline but needs cost predictability.
- Cost sensitivity: unit-cost per token must be competitive vs our in-house ops. Looking to reduce token cost via batching/caching + quantization. Target <$0.0009/token effective for chat path.
- Model preferences: open Llama-family variants and Mistral-like if available. Want quantized variants (4-bit / int8) validated.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant acceptable if quality delta within thresholds; need canary rollout support.
- Observability: token-level latency breakdown, KV cache hit rates, per-route cost analytics.
- Security/compliance: enforce SSO (SAML), per-tenant audit logs, KMS-managed key rotation, data residency in NA; no raw log export without signed addendum.
